site.name: moonlight-tickets
site.summary: moonlight-tickets-clone Fictional independent live-music ticketing platform "MoonlightTickets". Dark after-dark theme. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Discovery page: "Tonight" 4 large cards + 4-axis filters (date / genre / venue / price) + "This week" 12-event grid of fictional shows | | `event.html` | Event detail: title, time, venue, doors; favorite / share; artist bio + 3 audio clips; 3 tier cards (Early Bird / Standard / VIP with stepper -/+, VIP shows a "SELLING FAST" badge); right-side sticky order summary with fee preview; venue GA sketch SVG; accessibility notes; 3 related events | | `checkout.html` | Top 10-minute reservation countdown (<1m red pulse); collapsible cart; one accordion attendee form per ticket (First / Last / Email / e-delivery toggle, VIP adds "Name for signed poster", non-first ticket includes Copy buyer info); 3 payment methods + card-number formatting; promo (DOORS5 / TONIGHT10); right-side detailed fee breakdown (subtotal + $3.50 service × n + $2 facility × n + 3% + $0.30 processing + promo discount); Cancel second-confirmation |

explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full moonlight-tickets system, prioritizing the primary checkout/booking flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: The moonlight-tickets system has a functional checkout flow with interactive form fields and payment options, but faces issues with ticket stepper interactivity, confirmation page navigation, and mobile viewport testing. Key gaps include unvisited confirmation.html, under-exercised mobile controls, and failed actions needing retries.

exploration_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the moonlight-tickets system, focusing on the checkout/booking flow, adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_plan.summary: The exploration will proceed in phases: starting with the discovery page (index.html) to understand filtering and event selection, then moving to event details (event.html) to explore ticket options, followed by the checkout process (checkout.html) to validate form flows and fee breakdowns, and finally confirming the booking (confirmation.html) and checking recovery paths. Mobile viewport checks will be included for critical interactions.
assumptions: The site has a dark theme with clear event cards and filtering options.
The checkout flow includes a reservation countdown and detailed fee breakdown.
Event pages have multiple ticket tiers and related event suggestions.
risk_hotspots: checkout.html (reservation countdown, attendee forms, promo codes)
event.html (ticket steppers, 'SELLING FAST' badge, related events)

phases.title: Discovery Page (index.html)
phases.objective: Validate filtering and event selection UX.
key_checks: Interact with date, genre, venue, and price filters to see if they update event lists.
Click on a 'Tonight' event card (e.g., 'Sea Glass Sextet') to navigate to event.html.
Check mobile viewport for filter and card tap targets (small tap target warnings noted).
exit_criteria: All filters interacted with, at least one event card clicked, mobile viewport checks completed.

phases.title: Event Detail (event.html)
phases.objective: Explore ticket tiers, favorites, sharing, and related events.
key_checks: Interact with ticket steppers (increase/decrease) for each tier.
Click 'favorite' and 'share' buttons to check functionality.
Explore related events section to see navigation.
Check mobile viewport for ticket stepper and button tap targets.
exit_criteria: All ticket tiers interacted with, favorite/share buttons checked, related events explored, mobile viewport checks completed.

phases.title: Checkout Flow (checkout.html)
phases.objective: Validate checkout form, fee breakdown, and promo codes.
key_checks: Interact with attendee forms (accordion, copy buyer info, VIP fields).
Test promo codes (DOORS5 / TONIGHT10) to check discount application.
Validate payment method selection and card number formatting.
Check mobile viewport for form fields and promo code input.
exit_criteria: Attendee forms completed, promo codes tested, payment methods explored, mobile viewport checks completed.

phases.title: Booking Confirmation (confirmation.html)
phases.objective: Validate booking confirmation and recovery paths.
key_checks: Click 'Cancel' (if available) to test recovery path to checkout or event page.
Check mobile viewport for confirmation message and recovery buttons.
exit_criteria: Confirmation details reviewed, recovery path tested, mobile viewport checks completed.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Checks (All Pages)
phases.objective: Repeat critical interactions in mobile viewport.
key_checks: Re-interact with filters, event cards, ticket steppers, and checkout forms in mobile viewport.
Verify tap target sizes and responsiveness for small targets (noted in prescan).
exit_criteria: Critical interactions repeated in mobile viewport, tap target issues validated.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all known HTML pages (index.html, event.html, checkout.html, confirmation.html).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise most visible controls (filters, ticket steppers, attendee forms, promo codes, recovery buttons) per key page.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (filters, ticket selection, checkout forms) on mobile viewport.

notes: Pay attention to the 10-minute reservation countdown in checkout.html and how it affects the flow.
Validate 'SELLING FAST' badge behavior on event.html if encountered.

findings.user_goal: Complete booking and view confirmation page
findings.problem: The 'confirmation.html' page could not be loaded via direct navigation, preventing validation of booking details and recovery options.
findings.evidence: Multiple attempts to open 'confirmation.html' failed; the browser remained on 'index.html' instead.
findings.why_it_matters: Users need to verify booking success and access post-booking actions (e.g., cancel, rebook). Failing to load this page creates uncertainty about the final booking state.
findings.suggestion: Verify the file path and navigation logic for 'confirmation.html' to ensure it loads correctly after a successful order. Add error handling or redirects if the page is missing.

findings.user_goal: Adjust ticket quantity for Early Bird tier
findings.problem: The Early Bird ticket stepper's 'increase' button failed to respond to a click, indicating potential interactivity issues.
findings.evidence: The click action on the Early Bird stepper (target_id ux-15) timed out, while the Standard stepper worked correctly.
findings.why_it_matters: Inconsistent stepper functionality confuses users and may prevent them from selecting their desired ticket tier/quantity.
findings.suggestion: Test and fix the Early Bird stepper's interactivity to ensure it responds consistently with other ticket tiers. Check for JavaScript errors or element visibility issues.

findings.problem: Mobile viewport testing was under-exercised (0/16 required actions), leaving mobile-specific UX issues (e.g., tap targets, responsiveness) untested.
findings.evidence: Coverage data shows 0 mobile actions were performed, while 16 were required.
findings.why_it_matters: Many users book tickets on mobile devices. Unchecked mobile UX risks poor usability (e.g., small tap targets, broken layouts) for a significant portion of users.
findings.suggestion: Test the checkout flow and all interactive elements (steppers, forms, buttons) in mobile viewport to identify and fix responsiveness or touch-target issues.

findings.user_goal: Adjust ticket quantity for Early Bird tier
findings.problem: The Early Bird ticket stepper's 'increase' button failed to respond to a click, indicating potential interactivity issues.
findings.evidence: The click action on the Early Bird stepper (target_id ux-15) timed out, while the Standard stepper worked correctly.
findings.why_it_matters: Inconsistent stepper functionality confuses users and may prevent them from selecting their desired ticket tier/quantity.
findings.suggestion: Test and fix the Early Bird stepper's interactivity to ensure it responds consistently with other ticket tiers. Check for JavaScript errors or element visibility issues.

findings.user_goal: Navigate the site using a keyboard or screen reader
findings.problem: Small tap targets (e.g., navigation links, ticket cards) may fail accessibility guidelines for mobile touch targets (minimum 44x44px).
findings.evidence: Layout warnings show tap targets like 'MoonlightTickets' (187x28px) and 'Tonight' (47x20px) are below mobile guidance.
findings.why_it_matters: Users with motor disabilities or using touchscreens may struggle to interact with small targets, leading to frustration or errors.
findings.suggestion: Increase the size of tap targets (e.g., navigation links, ticket cards) to meet mobile accessibility standards (minimum 44x44px) or add padding to improve touchability.

findings.problem: The cancellation flow redirects to 'index.html' without confirming the cart is cleared or providing a recovery path (e.g., return to event page).
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Yes, cancel' on checkout.html redirects to 'index.html', with no confirmation message or option to resume the booking.
findings.why_it_matters: Users may cancel accidentally or change their mind. Failing to confirm cancellation or provide a recovery path increases friction and may lead to lost sales.
findings.suggestion: After cancellation, display a confirmation message and offer options to 'Resume Booking' (return to checkout) or 'Explore More Events' (stay on index.html).
